summary: Kingsway Corp filed an 8-K reporting a routine corporate name change from Kingsway Financial Services Inc. to Kingsway Corporation, effective May 18, 2026 after shareholder approval at the annual meeting. The certificate of amendment to the restated certificate of incorporation and bylaw amendment solely reflect the name change with no effect on shareholder rights. The common stock ticker changed to KWY on the NYSE effective May 19, 2026; CUSIP unchanged. The filing is a routine current report, not a special situation event.
